newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waigel-leaders may agree details of budget pact.
newsitem.headline: Waigel-leaders may agree details of budget pact.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Friday that EU finance ministers had failed to agree on key figures for a budget pact but that the leaders of the EU states may resolve this final detail later on Friday.

In a briefing after talks with EU finance ministers, Waigel said Germany was maintaining its position that the stability pact had to be finalised in all main details before agreement could be reached on the legal framework for the single European currency and a mechanism to link other currencies to the euro.
"Our general reservation (against approving these issues separately) remains until we have agreed all figures," he said.
